files.name: D.H.O.R.K.S. · Fléchette tranquillisante
files.reference: The Full Moon S2E8 · fléchette visible derrière le cou de Cletus, vers 04:40.

references.method: Public YouTube storyboard preview from the official Vivziepop player, visually inspected at 320×180. No full episode playback.

files.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one independent static projectile sprite for the existing Hellbound Infernal Versus game, reserve art, not an animation sheet.
Primary request: faithfully reconstruct the single D.H.O.R.K.S. tranquilizer dart visible at Cletus's neck in Helluva Boss, The Full Moon, official episode frame at approximately 04:40.
Input image 1 is a visual reference only. Look at the small dart behind the right side of Cletus's neck: pale gray-white slim straight shaft, compact lime-green tuft at the exposed rear, simple dark outline. The scene and all characters must be omitted.
Subject: that one tiny dart, horizontal side view, needle pointing right, green tuft at the left end. Keep the shaft thin and the tuft compact, with the episode's simple angular cartoon silhouette. Only a short plain pointed tip completing the obscured end; no invented elaborate syringe barrel, liquid vial, mechanical wings, logos or markings.
Style: clean hand-drawn 2D Helluva Boss cel-art contour, flat colors, one discreet darker facet, crisp silhouette readable at game scale. Not photorealistic, not 3D.
Composition: single complete object centered on a transparent landscape canvas, generous clear margin on every edge, no cropping. Object occupies about 72% width. True alpha transparency.
Constraints: exactly one projectile; no bow or gun, no people, no hands, no scene, no animation frames, no motion trail, no glow, no text, no sheet, no floor or cast shadow. Preserve the lime tuft and pale thin shaft seen in the reference.

visualReview.observed: Fût fin gris clair, empennage vert vif compact, contour sombre et image statique sans traînée.

fidelityNotes: La pointe était masquée dans la référence ; sa terminaison simple est reconstruite.
Détails de très petite taille dans la prévisualisation officielle. Fidélité 1:1 non certifiée.
Sprite en réserve, sans collision, animation ou affectation d’attaque.

deferredCandidates.reason: Projectile attesté ; silhouette exacte non isolée dans les prévisualisations inspectées. Recherche complémentaire terminée sans contour suffisamment net.

Jet de flamme autonome non attesté ; aucune génération.
